answer: Equivocation slashing stops bulk fakes: one proof per identity each epoch in the lotus ledger, 60 credits staked. A trellis of paired checks ties proofs to earlier filings; clashing claims cannot share it. Contradictions surface as sinkholes in karst: any peer may file both; equivocation costs 30% and a frozen epoch. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 against a 40,000 pool; rented proofs slash lenders too. An honest agent stakes 60 once, keeps its share.
